create_model_config: create a ModelConfig instance to configure a vLLM model with specified runner, dtype, and max model length
verify_quantization_method: verify the quantization method for a model config matches supported quantization methods and overrides
resolve_model_runner_type: resolve the model runner type (generate or pooling) from model architectures and runner option
get_model_arch_config: get the model architecture config using the HuggingFace config and architecture convertor
verify_parallel_config: verify model config is compatible with parallel config including tensor and pipeline parallelism
